description: This file defines the ServiceEcaArtifactInfo class, which provides information about Service ECA (Event-Condition-Action) rules within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages properties such as the associated rule, called services, display naming, and relationship mapping for visualization or analysis.

classes.name: ServiceEcaArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a Service ECA rule, including its name, location, called services, and relationships for visualization or processing within the system.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates the set of services called by this Service ECA rule by analyzing its actions and updating internal references.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the Service ECA, typically used for UI presentation.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns a static string describing the type of artifact, in this case 'Service ECA'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the internal identifier for this artifact type.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique string identifier for this Service ECA, based on its rule.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL location of the Service ECA definition.

methods.name: getServiceEcaRule
methods.description: Returns the underlying ServiceEcaRule object associated with this artifact.

methods.name: setDisplayPrefix
methods.description: Sets an optional prefix for display naming purposes.

methods.name: setDisplaySuffixNum
methods.description: Sets a numeric suffix for display naming to differentiate multiple related artifacts.

methods.name: getDisplayPrefixedName
methods.description: Constructs and returns a display name that includes optional prefix, service name, event name, and suffix.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByServiceEcaActions
methods.description: Returns the set of services invoked by the actions within this Service ECA.

methods.name: getServicesTriggeringServiceEca
methods.description: Returns services that trigger this Service ECA rule, obtained via the factory's reference.

methods.name: createEoModelMap
methods.description: Creates a map representation of the Service ECA for modeling purposes, including attributes, conditions, actions, and relationships.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the underlying ServiceEcaRule object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the string representation of the object.
